title: Russian Pappardelle Bake
description: A hearty Russian-inspired pasta bake with a rich and tangy flavor.
instructions: Cook the pappardelle according to the package instructions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the pasta sauce to the skillet and stir to combine. Bring the sauce to a simmer and let cook for 2-3 minutes until heated through.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked pappardelle, pasta sauce mixture, quaint ricotta, and shredded mozzarella. Mix well to combine.
Transfer the pappardelle mixture to a baking dish and top with additional mozzarella cheese if desired.
Bake the pappardelle in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the pappardelle from the oven and sprinkle with chopped fresh parsley. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the Russian pappardelle bake hot and enjoy!
